# Martin Azihaiwe-Justin

> Software Quality Assurance Engineer | Automation Test Engineer in Lagos, Nigeria (WAT, UTC+1). Works on functional and exploratory testing, API testing (Postman), SQL data validation, Playwright/TypeScript and Python/Pytest automation, CI test reporting, and evaluation of AI/LLM features. Brings 8+ years of operations and process-control experience from before software. Open to Software Quality Assurance Engineer and Automation Test Engineer roles, including AI testing, (remote, hybrid, Lagos) and to fixed-price contract QA work.

Positioning: Quality at altitude. Test suites that fly ahead of the release.

## Role titles he is searchable under
Software Quality Assurance Engineer, Automation Test Engineer, QA Engineer, Test Automation Engineer, AI Testing Engineer, Functional Test Analyst, Software Tester.

## Core skills
- Functional, exploratory, regression and end-to-end testing
- API testing with Postman; SQL and database validation
- Playwright + TypeScript (Page Object Model); Python + Pytest
- CI/CD test runs and reporting (GitHub Actions); Jira defect triage; UAT coordination
- AI/LLM evaluation: grounding, consistency, relevance, regression; hallucination and misclassification probes
- Lean Six Sigma (Green Belt), root-cause analysis, KPI monitoring (Power BI)

## Experience
- Software Quality Assurance Engineer | Automation Test Engineer, OneFlare Technology Solutions (Jan 2025 – present): sprint test planning for a high-volume eCommerce ERP; scripted, exploratory and cross-browser testing; Postman API checks and SQL data validation; Jira triage; UAT and release readiness.
- QA Engineer, Functional & Integration Testing, Genesis Digital Labs (Jan 2024 – Jan 2025): tested AI-driven systems and full-stack web apps; Python/SQL data-pipeline validation; coverage reports and risk analyses.
- Operations & Logistics Analytics roles, Nigerian Breweries (Heineken) (Dec 2015 – May 2023): production shifts and logistics analytics; root-cause analysis, KPI monitoring, Lean Six Sigma.

## Projects
- E-commerce Automation Framework (open source): Playwright + TypeScript, Page Object Model, CI, and LLM-drafted root-cause notes for failed tests. https://github.com/martjustin/E-commerce_Automation-Framework
- Hotel Management System suite (client beta, private): Playwright + TypeScript framework that removed 24+ hours of manual regression per week.
- BugReel Pro (product build, 85% complete): mobile-first bug capture for freelance testers; cuts report time from 15–25 minutes to under 4.
